requests.title: Bring me a Muscle Drink
requests.solution: Buy a Muscle Drink from Aohige Pharmacy at Paulownia Mall and keep it for Elizabeth. This route buys it during the April 25 Saturday sale and reports the request on May 10. Buying the drink is preparation; bring it to Elizabeth to finish.

requests.title: Retrieve the First Old Document
requests.solution: Open the purple chest at Thebel's 22F border and keep Old Document 01. The route collects it on April 23, then hands it to Elizabeth on May 10 for ¥10,000. Reaching the border without collecting and reporting the document does not finish the request.

requests.title: Shadow Hunting Milestone
requests.solution: Defeat a total of 100 Shadows in Tartarus. Check the request with Elizabeth during return visits and report when the target is met. Mark Reported after the in-game hand-in.

requests.title: Treasure Hunting Milestone
requests.solution: Open a total of 50 treasure chests while exploring Tartarus. Check the request with Elizabeth and report once the target is met. Mark Reported after the in-game hand-in.

requests.title: Create a Persona that’s Level 13 or Above
requests.solution: Create or level a Persona to at least level 13. Keep it in your carried Personas and report to Elizabeth. Check the Persona’s level, not only the protagonist’s level.

requests.title: Create a Persona with Kouha
requests.solution: Obtain Archangel through fusion or Shuffle Time and retain Kouha in its skill list. Carry it when you report to Elizabeth; a Compendium entry alone is not the requested Persona in your possession.

requests.title: Bring me a Juzumaru
requests.solution: Defeat the gatekeeper on Tartarus 36F in Arqa, then use three Twilight Fragments to open the locked chest containing Juzumaru. Keep the sword and show it to Elizabeth before selling it. Reaching the floor or defeating its boss alone does not complete the request.

requests.title: Experiment with Fortune Telling
requests.solution: Before a Tartarus visit, buy the ¥3,000 Rarity Fortune from the fortune teller in Club Escapade at Paulownia Mall. Explore Tartarus that same night, then report the experiment to Elizabeth.
requests.availabilityNotes: Reach Tartarus 12F and check the fortune teller in Club Escapade before the experiment.

requests.title: I’d like to try all kinds of drinks
requests.solution: After Request #1, collect 12 different vending-machine drinks. Use Dorm 2F, Dorm 3F, Port Island Station and Iwatodai Strip Mall 3F. The Iwatodai Station selection duplicates Dorm 2F, so extra copies do not replace missing varieties. Bring the complete set to Elizabeth.

requests.title: I’d like to try a beef bowl
requests.solution: Buy the Umiushi Fan Book for ¥450 at MangaStar Net Café and read it on the dorm's shared computer. Then buy an Umiushi Beef Bowl from Umiushi Beef Bowls on Iwatodai Strip Mall 3F and bring it to Elizabeth. The route purchases the bowl on June 4; reading the book only enables the purchase.

requests.title: Please prevail in the Big Eater Challenge
requests.solution: Accept the request after the route's drink hand-in, then take the Big Eater Challenge at Wilduck Burger. Choose options 2 → 1 → 2: look away from the burgers, eat without stopping, and imagine something sour. After winning, report to Elizabeth; accepting the challenge is not completion.

requests.title: Bring me pine resin
requests.solution: Accept the request before asking Yukari at the dorm for Pine Resin. Bring the resin back to Elizabeth by June 6. The route handles collection and reporting on May 10; do not stop after receiving the item.

requests.title: Bring me a handheld game console
requests.solution: Finish Request #12, then accept this request and ask Junpei at the dorm for the Handheld Game Console. Return it to Elizabeth by June 6. The route completes the chain on May 10.

requests.title: Retrieve the Second Old Document
requests.solution: Collect Old Document 02 at the 43F border during the May 24 climb, then hand it to Elizabeth for ¥20,000. Keep the document until the hand-in; the reward only counts toward your budget after reporting.

requests.title: Shadow hunting Milestone 2
requests.solution: Defeat a total of 200 Shadows in Tartarus. Check the request with Elizabeth during return visits and report when the target is met. Mark Reported after the in-game hand-in.

requests.title: Treasure Hunting Milestone 2
requests.solution: Open a total of 100 treasure chests while exploring Tartarus. Check the request with Elizabeth and report once the target is met. Mark Reported after the in-game hand-in.

requests.title: Fusion Series 1: Emperor, Oberon
requests.solution: Create Oberon and keep Mazio in its skill list, learning it through leveling if needed. Show Elizabeth the carried Oberon with Mazio; another Persona with the skill does not meet this request.

requests.title: I’d like to be gifted a bouquet of flowers
requests.solution: Buy a Rose Bouquet for ¥2,000 from the flower shop at Port Island Station. Keep it in your inventory and bring it to Elizabeth.

requests.title: I want Jack Frost dolls
requests.solution: Check the crane machine by the Paulownia Mall arcade when its displayed prize is Jack Frost. Play until you have three Jack Frost dolls, then bring all three to Elizabeth. Each attempt costs ¥200 and may fail, so budget for retries.

requests.title: Bring me some potent medicine
requests.solution: Accept the request and visit the school Nurse's Office for Potent Medicine. This route schedules the pickup on June 15. Keep the medicine and return it to Elizabeth; the pickup task alone is not a completed hand-in.

requests.title: Retrieve the third old document
requests.solution: Collect Old Document 03 from the chest at Tartarus 69F and bring it to Elizabeth. Reaching the floor is preparation; collect the document and report the request before marking it Reported.

requests.title: Shadow Hunting Milestone 3
requests.solution: Defeat a total of 300 Shadows in Tartarus. Check the request with Elizabeth during return visits and report when the target is met. Mark Reported after the in-game hand-in.

requests.title: Persona Fusion Milestone
requests.solution: Perform a total of 20 Persona fusions in the Velvet Room. Work toward this while creating Personas for the route, then report the milestone to Elizabeth.

requests.title: Create a Persona that’s level 23 or above
requests.solution: Create or level a Persona to at least level 23. Keep it in your carried Personas and report to Elizabeth. Check the Persona’s level, not only the protagonist’s level.

requests.title: Fusion Series 2: Chariot, Mithras
requests.solution: Use the Velvet Room fusion search to create Mithras, then raise it to level 26 or higher. Check the Persona’s own level and carry it when reporting to Elizabeth.

requests.title: Bring me an Onimaru Kunitsuma
requests.solution: Search the treasure chests on Tartarus 54F in Arqa for Onimaru Kunitsuma. Keep the weapon and show it to Elizabeth before selling it.

requests.title: Bring me a triangular sword
requests.solution: Accept the request, ask Mitsuru at the dorm for the Fencing Epee, then hand it to Elizabeth. Finish by July 5. The route does this on June 14 and follows it with Request #28.

requests.title: Bring me a protein not for pros
requests.solution: Report Request #27 first, then accept this request. Ask Akihiko at the dorm for Amateur Protein and bring it back to Elizabeth by July 5. The route completes both requests on June 14.

requests.title: I want to look fashionable
requests.solution: Accept the request on the June 14 route visit. During the June 27 Tartarus climb, obtain a Black Quartz from a Formidable Shadow or the relevant rescue reward. Keep it for the discounted fashionable-item purchase at Club Escapade on June 28, then take the item to Elizabeth by July 5. The Quartz itself is not the requested item.

requests.title: Retrieve the Fourth Old Document
requests.solution: Collect Old Document 04 from the chest at Tartarus 92F and bring it to Elizabeth. Reaching the floor is preparation; collect the document and report the request before marking it Reported.

requests.title: Shadow Hunting Milestone 4
requests.solution: Defeat a total of 450 Shadows in Tartarus. Check the request with Elizabeth during return visits and report when the target is met. Mark Reported after the in-game hand-in.

requests.title: Treasure Hunting Milestone 3
requests.solution: Open a total of 150 treasure chests while exploring Tartarus. Check the request with Elizabeth and report once the target is met. Mark Reported after the in-game hand-in.

requests.title: Persona Fusion Milestone 2
requests.solution: Perform a total of 35 Persona fusions in the Velvet Room. Work toward this while creating Personas for the route, then report the milestone to Elizabeth.

requests.title: Create a Persona with Torrent Shot
requests.solution: Create Eligor and retain Torrent Shot. One fusion pairing is Mokoi with Leanan Sidhe; check the result preview before confirming. Carry the Persona with Torrent Shot when you report to Elizabeth.

requests.title: Fusion Series 3: Hermit, Mothman
requests.solution: Create Mothman with Agilao inherited from a parent that knows it. Lamia with Agilao plus Dakini is one pairing to preview. Select Agilao during skill inheritance, then carry the resulting Mothman when reporting.

requests.title: Defeat a Rare Shadow 1
requests.solution: Hunt a rare Shadow in Yabbashah and collect its Rustic Coin. A Rarity Fortune before the trip can help with encounters. Keep one coin for Elizabeth and report after collecting it.

requests.title: Traverse the Monad Passage
requests.solution: Clear the enemies inside the Monad Passage on Tartarus 91F in Yabbashah, then report to Elizabeth. Entering the passage or clearing a different Monad Door does not finish this objective.
requests.availabilityNotes: Clear the Monad Door on 80F to receive this request. Its objective is the fixed Monad Passage on 91F.

requests.title: I want to eat some chilled Taiyaki
requests.solution: Read the School X Site Note to unlock Lukewarm Taiyaki at the School Store, then buy one and chill it in the dorm kitchen fridge. The route places one on June 30 and retrieves the Chilled Taiyaki on July 1. Save it, accept Request #38 on July 9, and hand it to Elizabeth.

requests.title: Let me hear music unique to Gekkoukan
requests.solution: Accept the request before entering Gekkoukan High's PA Room. Obtain the Gekkoukan Boogie CD there, then bring it back to Elizabeth. The route completes this on July 9.

requests.title: I’d like to see a pair of Max Safety Shoes
requests.solution: Accept the request, then buy the ¥9,800 Max Safety Shoes set from TV Shopping on July 12. Wait for delivery and show Elizabeth the shoes; the route reports them on July 18. Placing the order is only preparation. Reporting this request opens the route's next autograph request.

itemWindow.note: The guide uses the July 12 TV shopping offer. Ordering the shoes does not prove delivery; keep the delivered pair for Elizabeth.

requests.title: Bring me the Mysterious Person’s Autograph
requests.solution: After reporting Request #40, accept this request. Bring Tanaka's Signature, obtained from starting the Devil Social Link, to Elizabeth. The route hands it over on July 18; the autograph must already be in your inventory.

requests.title: Please feed the cat
requests.solution: Accept the request and buy four Super Cat Food at Aohige Pharmacy. Feed the weak cat at the Station Outskirts on four separate visits; this route uses July 9, 10, 11 and 13. After the fourth feeding, report to Elizabeth. Buying all four portions or feeding the cat once does not finish the request.

requests.title: Bring me a Christmas Star
requests.solution: Accept the request, then speak to Fuuka at the dorm for the Poinsettia. Return it to Elizabeth by August 4. The route obtains and reports it on July 9; keep the item until the hand-in.

requests.title: I wish to feel the ocean
requests.solution: Accept this request before the Yakushima trip so the beach-item interaction is available. Collect a Pretty Seashell or another beach souvenir on July 20 or 21. After returning, bring it to Elizabeth; the route reports on July 23, before the August 4 cutoff.

itemWindow.note: Collect a beach souvenir during the Yakushima trip and keep it for Elizabeth. The route collects one on July 20 or July 21.

requests.title: Retrieve the Fifth Old Document
requests.solution: Collect Old Document 05 from the chest at Tartarus 118F and bring it to Elizabeth. Reaching the floor is preparation; collect the document and report the request before marking it Reported.

requests.title: Shadow Hunting Milestone 5
requests.solution: Defeat a total of 600 Shadows in Tartarus. Check the request with Elizabeth during return visits and report when the target is met. Mark Reported after the in-game hand-in.

requests.title: Treasure Hunting Milestone 4
requests.solution: Open a total of 200 treasure chests while exploring Tartarus. Check the request with Elizabeth and report once the target is met. Mark Reported after the in-game hand-in.

requests.title: Persona Fusion Milestone 3
requests.solution: Perform a total of 50 Persona fusions in the Velvet Room. Work toward this while creating Personas for the route, then report the milestone to Elizabeth.

requests.title: Create a Persona that’s level 38 or above
requests.solution: Create or level a Persona to at least level 38. Keep it in your carried Personas and report to Elizabeth. Check the Persona’s level, not only the protagonist’s level.

requests.title: Perform King and I
requests.solution: Register King Frost and Black Frost in the Compendium to unlock King and I. Charge the protagonist’s Theurgy gauge, use King and I in battle, then report to Elizabeth. Unlocking the move is preparation for performing it.

requests.title: Bring me an Outenta Mitsuyo
requests.solution: Visit Mayoido Antiques at Paulownia Mall and select the Outenta Mitsuyo weapon recipe. Gather the materials listed by the shop, craft the weapon, and show it to Elizabeth before selling it.

requests.title: I’d Like to Try a Home-Cooked Meal
requests.solution: Save the Iron-Athlete Meal from the route's June 17 cooking hangout with Akihiko. Once this request is available and accepted, bring the saved meal to Elizabeth. The early cooking date is preparation, not the request's unlock date or a report.

requests.title: I’d like to see a Mysterious Potato
requests.solution: Buy a Buff Potato Sprout at Rafflesia in Port Island Station and grow it in the dorm rooftop garden. Harvest and save a Tarukaja Potato for Elizabeth. This route plants on June 4 and harvests on June 16 as advance preparation; report once the request is available.
requests.availabilityNotes: Report #52 and finish the Iwatodai Station outing (#78). The route plants and saves the potato earlier as preparation.

requests.title: Attempt a hundred shrine visits
requests.solution: Accept the request, then check Naganaki Shrine's Monetary Offering three times. The route uses August 8, August 9 and August 20; these checks do not consume the daytime slot. On the third visit, take the found 500-yen bill to Elizabeth. The request title does not require one hundred actual visits.

requests.title: I’d like to see proof of a bond
requests.solution: Max a Social Link and retain its max-rank item. This route uses the item obtained when Devil reaches MAX on September 1. Show it to Elizabeth to report the request; a lower Social Link rank is not enough.

requests.title: Look for the drink with my name
requests.solution: Accept the request, then visit Que Sera Sera in Station Outskirts and ask for the drink named after Elizabeth. If entry is refused, raise Charm and return. Bring the drink back to Elizabeth.
requests.availabilityNotes: Que Sera Sera in Station Outskirts requires Charm rank 5. Accept this request before asking for the named drink.

requests.title: I’d Like to Try Aojiru
requests.solution: Ask about Aojiru at Aohige Pharmacy in Paulownia Mall. Trade two Topaz and one Turquoise for a Vintage Yagen at Mayoido Antiques, then exchange the Yagen at the pharmacy for True Aohige Aojiru. Bring that drink to Elizabeth.

requests.title: I wish to become a straw millionaire
requests.solution: Accept the request and take Elizabeth's Wrapped Bandage. Trade it at Port Island Station Outskirts for the Student Handbook; trade the handbook at Port Island Station for Irresistible Catnip; trade the catnip to the cat-loving boy at Iwatodai Strip Mall for the Cat Ear Headband. Return the headband to Elizabeth by August 31. The route completes the chain on August 8.

requests.title: Retrieve the Sixth Old Document
requests.solution: Collect Old Document 06 from the chest at Tartarus 144F and bring it to Elizabeth. Reaching the floor is preparation; collect the document and report the request before marking it Reported.

requests.title: Shadow Hunting Milestone 6
requests.solution: Defeat a total of 800 Shadows in Tartarus. Check the request with Elizabeth during return visits and report when the target is met. Mark Reported after the in-game hand-in.

requests.title: Create a Persona that’s level 46 or above
requests.solution: Create or level a Persona to at least level 46. Keep it in your carried Personas and report to Elizabeth. Check the Persona’s level, not only the protagonist’s level.

requests.title: Fusion Series 4: Lovers, Titania
requests.solution: Create Titania with Matarukaja, inheriting the skill during fusion or teaching it with a skill card. Check for Matarukaja, not the single-target Tarukaja, and carry Titania when reporting to Elizabeth.

requests.title: Fusion Series 5: Magician, Rangda
requests.solution: Create Rangda with the Velvet Room fusion search. Magician Social Link experience can help raise its level after fusion; otherwise level it in battle until it reaches at least 54. Carry that Rangda when reporting to Elizabeth.

requests.title: Defeat a Rare Shadow 2
requests.solution: Defeat a rare Shadow in Tziah and keep its Sumptuous Coin for Elizabeth. A Rarity Fortune before entering Tartarus can help you find rare Shadows. Report with the coin after the battle.

requests.title: Bring me an Ote-gine
requests.solution: After clearing the boss on Tartarus 143F, check that floor’s special treasure chests for Ote-gine. Keep the weapon and show it to Elizabeth.

requests.title: Bring me a Giant, Creepy Doll
requests.solution: Accept the request and visit the school laboratory while school is accessible. Collect the teaching doll and bring it to Elizabeth. Complete the pickup on a school visit instead of leaving it for the final day.

requests.title: Find me a Beautiful Tile
requests.solution: After accepting the request, visit Mahjong Parlor Red Hawk in Station Outskirts. Check your Courage if entry is refused; this route has already maxed it before this visit. Complete the interaction there, keep the peacock tile, and bring it to Elizabeth.
requests.availabilityNotes: Take the Scrub Brush reward after reporting; it is needed for the later restroom request (#92).

requests.title: Bring me a Fruit Knife
requests.solution: Accept the request before speaking to Shinjiro at the dorm for the Fruit Knife. Return it to Elizabeth by October 2. The route reports it on September 10, then starts Request #69.

requests.title: Bring me Oil
requests.solution: Finish Request #68 before accepting this request. Ask Aigis at the dorm for Machine Oil, then return it to Elizabeth by October 2. The route completes the chain on September 10.

requests.title: Retrieve the Seventh Old Document
requests.solution: Collect Old Document 07 from the chest at Tartarus 172F and bring it to Elizabeth. Reaching the floor is preparation; collect the document and report the request before marking it Reported.

requests.title: Fusion Series 6: Strength, Siegfried
requests.solution: Create Siegfried, then teach it Endure using the skill card rewarded by Request #73. Keep the skill and carry Siegfried when reporting to Elizabeth.

requests.title: Fusion Series 7: Hierophant, Daisoujou
requests.solution: Create Daisoujou with Regenerate 3 inherited from Suzaku. Use fusion search to preview a Daisoujou result, select Regenerate 3 for inheritance, and carry the finished Persona to Elizabeth.

requests.title: Bring me a Mikazuki Munechika
requests.solution: Craft Mikazuki Munechika at Mayoido Antiques using a Quality Nihil Blade, three Emeralds and two Silver Quartz. Show Elizabeth the finished weapon. The Endure card reward can then help with Request #71.

requests.title: I’d Like to Try Sushi
requests.solution: Accept the request before inspecting the Inari at Naganaki Shrine. Collect Inari Sushi and return it to Elizabeth. The route handles this on October 6; visiting the shrine without the accepted request is not the instructed pickup.
requests.availabilityNotes: Accept the request before checking the Inari. If your Academics is below the route’s level and the interaction is refused, improve it and return.

requests.title: Bring me a Helm from the Sengoku Era
requests.solution: Accept the request before beginning the Faculty Office visits. Make eight visits: this route uses October 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 17, 19 and 20. Receive Kanetsugu's Helm on the eighth visit and hand it to Elizabeth. Earlier visits advance the chain but do not finish it.

requests.title: Bring me a Glasses Wipe
requests.solution: Accept the request on the October 6 route visit. Speak to Ikutsuki for the Glasses Wipe on October 7 and return it to Elizabeth. Report by November 1; obtaining the wipe is only the pickup stage.

requests.title: I’d Like to Walk Around Paulownia Mall
requests.solution: When Elizabeth offers this outing, speak to her at the Velvet Room entrance during the day and choose to go out with her. Complete the visit to Paulownia Mall before marking the request Reported. Accepting the invitation alone does not complete the visit.
requests.availabilityNotes: Elizabeth offers outings according to the combined challenge levels of reported requests; the number of completed requests alone is not the requirement. Check her invitation. This outing is a daytime visit.

requests.title: I’d Like to Visit Iwatodai Station
requests.solution: When Elizabeth offers this outing, speak to her at the Velvet Room entrance during the day and choose to go out with her. Complete the visit to Iwatodai Station before marking the request Reported. Accepting the invitation alone does not complete the visit.
requests.reward: Book of the Ancients (Unlocks Thoth fusion)
requests.availabilityNotes: Elizabeth offers outings according to the combined challenge levels of reported requests; the number of completed requests alone is not the requirement. Wait at least three days after the preceding outing, then check her invitation. This outing is a daytime visit.

requests.title: I’d Like to Visit Naganaki Shrine
requests.solution: When Elizabeth offers this outing, speak to her at the Velvet Room entrance during the day and choose to go out with her. Complete the visit to Naganaki Shrine before marking the request Reported. Accepting the invitation alone does not complete the visit.
requests.availabilityNotes: Elizabeth offers outings according to the combined challenge levels of reported requests; the number of completed requests alone is not the requirement. Wait at least three days after the preceding outing, then check her invitation. This outing is a daytime visit.

requests.title: I’d Like to Visit Gekkoukan High
requests.solution: When Elizabeth offers this outing, speak to her at the Velvet Room entrance during the day and choose to go out with her. Complete the visit to Gekkoukan High before marking the request Reported. Accepting the invitation alone does not complete the visit.
requests.availabilityNotes: Elizabeth offers outings according to the combined challenge levels of reported requests; the number of completed requests alone is not the requirement. Wait at least three days after the preceding outing, then check her invitation. This outing needs an after-school visit.

requests.title: I’d Like to Visit your Room
requests.solution: When Elizabeth offers this outing, speak to her at the Velvet Room entrance during the day and choose to go out with her. Complete the visit to your dorm room before marking the request Reported. Accepting the invitation alone does not complete the visit.
requests.availabilityNotes: Elizabeth offers outings according to the combined challenge levels of reported requests; the number of completed requests alone is not the requirement. Wait at least three days after the preceding outing, then check her invitation. This outing is a daytime visit.

requests.title: Retrieve the Last Old Document
requests.solution: Collect Old Document 08 from the chest at Tartarus 198F and bring it to Elizabeth. Reaching the floor is preparation; collect the document and report the request before marking it Reported.

requests.title: Bring the Progress Report
requests.solution: Collect Progress Report from the chest at Tartarus 226F and bring it to Elizabeth. Reaching the floor is preparation; collect the document and report the request before marking it Reported.

requests.title: Create a Persona with Tempest Slash
requests.solution: Obtain Chernobog through fusion and keep its Tempest Slash skill. Carry it when reporting to Elizabeth.

requests.title: Create a Persona with Auto-Marakukaja
requests.solution: Create Hecatoncheires and level it to 53 to learn Auto-Maraku. Keep that skill and carry the Persona to Elizabeth. The automatic defense buff is the requested skill; ordinary Marakukaja is different.

requests.title: Fusion Series 8: Death, Alice
requests.solution: Use Special Fusion with Pixie, Lilim, Narcissus and Titania to create Alice. Keep Alice in your carried Personas and report to Elizabeth.

requests.title: Fusion Series 9: Fool, Loki
requests.solution: Create Loki, then raise it to at least level 75. Keep that Loki in your carried Personas and report to Elizabeth.

requests.title: Defeat a Greedy Shadow
requests.solution: Catch and defeat a Greedy Shadow in Harabah, then keep its Gold Medal. Bring one Gold Medal to Elizabeth; a rare Shadow’s coin is a different request item.

requests.title: Bring me a Rai Kunimitsu
requests.solution: Clear the boss on Tartarus 184F and open the locked treasure chest containing Rai Kunimitsu. Keep the weapon and show it to Elizabeth.

requests.title: Bring me a Dojigiri Yasutsuna
requests.solution: Open the locked treasure chests on Tartarus 212F in Harabah to obtain Dojigiri Yasutsuna. Keep the weapon and show it to Elizabeth.

requests.title: Bring me a Tonbo-kiri
requests.solution: Craft Tonbo-kiri at Mayoido Antiques using one Prime Nihil Blade, five Diamonds and two Gold Quartz. Check the base material carefully: the recipe needs the Prime version. Keep the finished spear and show it to Elizabeth before selling it.

requests.title: Go Clean a Restroom
requests.solution: Accept the request, enter the Port Island Station restroom, and choose to scrub harder until it is clean. Return to Elizabeth to report the work. The route completes this on November 6.

requests.title: Go Water the Flowers
requests.solution: Accept the request, visit Gekkoukan High's rooftop, and water the flowers. Return to Elizabeth to report the work. The route completes this on November 6.

requests.title: Bring me a Food for a Furry Friend
requests.solution: Accept the request and talk to Koromaru for Gourmet Dog Food. Bring it to Elizabeth by November 30. The route reports on November 6, then accepts Request #95; do not confuse accepting the next request with completing it.

requests.title: Bring me a Featherman R Action Figure
requests.solution: After reporting Request #94, accept this request and ask Ken for the Featherman R action figure. Bring it to Elizabeth by November 30. The route completes the hand-in on November 6.

requests.title: I’d Like to Try Oden Juice
requests.solution: Accept the request and talk to the Friendly Student by the Persimmon Tree before the Kyoto trip. In Kyoto, buy Durian Soda, Jumbo Juice and V6 from the vending machine; keep all three. After returning, trade them with the Friendly Student and pay ¥5,000 for Oden Juice, then take it to Elizabeth. The route prepares on November 6, buys the drinks on November 17, and reports on November 28.

itemWindow.note: Buy every Kyoto vending-machine drink during the school trip. Keep the set for the later Oden Juice trade; the drinks cannot be replaced by buying Oden Juice early.

requests.title: Bring me my Christmas Present
requests.solution: Accept the request before speaking to the Eccentric Man on Iwatodai Strip Mall 2F. Show a Thank-You Letter from a rescued Tartarus victim to receive the Christmas Present. Return the present to Elizabeth by December 25. The route completes this on December 4; a rescue or the letter alone is not the hand-in.
requests.availabilityNotes: Rescue a missing person and collect the Letter of Thanks from the police station before the Christmas Present trade.

requests.title: Fusion Series 10: Tower, Masakado
requests.solution: Once the request is available, prepare a Masakado that knows Charge and report it to Elizabeth. Check the skill before confirming your fusion. The route plans the report around the January 15 climb; fusing Masakado without Charge does not meet the request.

requests.title: Defeat the Shadow of the Void
requests.solution:
Clear the final Monad Passage on 255F and defeat the Shadow of the Void, then return to Elizabeth to report. The route completes this during the January 15 climb. This is separate from the later solo ultimate-adversary challenge for Request #101.

Battle plan: enter with charged Theurgy gauges. The boss restores 300 HP each turn and uses Diarahan at half health. Save your burst for after that full heal, then build damage and spend your strongest single-target attacks and Theurgies to finish. Guard after Charge to withstand Akasha Arts, or after Concentrate to withstand Megidolaon; restore the party before resuming damage.
requests.availabilityNotes: Report #37 and defeat the gatekeeper on 255F to enter that floor’s Monad Passage. Obtain the drop, then report to Elizabeth.

requests.title: Bring me a Bloody Button
requests.solution: Defeat the Reaper, keep the Bloody Button, and return it to Elizabeth. The route reports this on January 21 and then accepts Request #101. The new acceptance is preparation for a separate fight; it does not report Request #101.

requests.title: Defeat the Ultimate Adversary
requests.solution:
Access: finish and report #99 and #100, accept #101, then enter the final Monad door on Tartarus 255F alone. This route schedules the attempt for January 30. Defeat Elizabeth, then report back; accepting the request alone does not complete it.

Prepare: aim for level 99 and strong Persona stats. Unlock Armageddon by registering Helel and Satan. Bring HP/SP restoratives, Heat Riser and Debilitate (skills or items), and ailment protection. Orpheus Telos is a strong main Persona because it resists damage without nullifying it; Concentrate, Diamond Dust and Ice damage passives provide a practical attack build. Carry Enduring Soul on a separate Persona and Endure on your finishing Persona, with both uses reserved. Shoes of Bane protect against Alice's Dark instant kill; do not let ordinary attacks or instant death consume either survival skill early.

Rules: finish before 50 turns. Never Null, Repel or Drain her damaging attacks; Resist is safe. Remove counterattack skills and avoid Tetrakarn/Makarakarn. Save Armageddon for the killing blow. Rule violations provoke repeated 9,999-damage Megidolaons.

Opening: track damage from 20,000 HP. Buff, debuff and Concentrate, then use Ice after Surt; heal or prepare when her current Persona resists your attack. Near 13,000 HP, set up burst damage before crossing the threshold.

First transition: her dialogue followed by Nebiros's Rakunda/Concentrate warns of the scripted Megidolaon. Equip your Enduring Soul Persona before it lands. Then push her below 10,000 HP within the next three player turns; a charged Scarlet Havoc can help. If Thor uses Concentrate/Charge, your next action is the last chance to pass this damage check before repeated Megidolaons.

Final phase: after Diarahan, reset your damage tally to 20,000 HP. She now attacks with two Personas per turn. Rebuild and preserve a full Theurgy gauge. Before the hit that takes her below 10,000 HP, equip your unused Endure Persona. Survive the grand-finale Megidolaon, then immediately use Armageddon to finish. Do not spend that final gauge on another Theurgy.
requests.availabilityNotes: Finish the room outing (#81) and report both #99 and #100. Accept #101 before attempting the solo battle; victory and reporting are separate.
